study_design.research_question: Can the explicitly invited hosted account return a canonical envelope whose six results match the hidden frozen oracle for newly frozen experiment-local Capsule cases in the existing public thread? Final Capsule conformance additionally requires a post-stop oracle semantic audit.
tested: strict raw public-response syntax and canonical JSON
closed response schema and identity bindings
one irrelevant metadata and prompt-injection invariance
not_tested: protocol promotion or state of the art
study_design.task_generation: Six new project-authored Urusilla-only cases were frozen after v1 stopped. No v1 task, public v1 answer key, raw-text arm, or ordinary-JSON arm is reused.
study_design.execution_context: One ongoing hosted public thread. Fresh sessions, separate arms, provider receipts, usage receipts, and model-settings receipts are neither required nor accepted as v2 evidence.

oracle_commitment.canonical_json: UTF-8, recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, preserved array order
oracle_commitment.commitment_proves: The revealed oracle existed in committed form before outreach if and only if the reveal matches this digest.
oracle_commitment.commitment_does_not_prove: Oracle correctness, participant independence, internal processing, adoption, or efficiency.

response_contract.entire_comment_body: one compact canonical JSON object with no Markdown, prose prefix, suffix, or trailing newline
response_contract.output_result: Exactly six result records in packet order and response_note null.
response_contract.non_result: results null and one non-empty public response_note of at most 1024 Unicode code points.
response_contract.identity_mismatch: Return the four observed syntactically valid identity values, require at least one mismatch, set results null, and explain the mismatch in response_note.

scoring_contract.raw_body_rule: Score the exact UTF-8 comment body. Never score a parsed object reserialized by the project as if it were the raw response.
scoring_contract.case_rule: After a valid reveal, compare each canonical result object exactly with its revealed oracle record.
scoring_contract.suite_exact_oracle_match_rule: True only when all six result records exactly match the valid revealed oracle and all registered metamorphic relations hold.
scoring_contract.oracle_semantic_correctness_rule: The pre-stop public verifier intentionally does not encode the six arithmetic answers. Oracle semantic correctness remains null until a separate post-stop audit is published; exact oracle match alone is not final Capsule conformance.
scoring_contract.safe_fallback_rule: An oracle-matching fail-closed fallback is safety-correct but is not a completed direct-urusilla case.
scoring_contract.missing_reveal_rule: All semantic and suite scores remain null; never coerce missing reveal to pass or fail.

stop_rule.response_parent: The exact v2 invitation comment ID recorded in the publication receipt.
stop_rule.trigger: The first direct-child public comment by the exact invited author after publication, regardless of whether it parses or passes, or the deadline, whichever occurs first.
stop_rule.malformed_or_negative_first_response: retain, classify, stop, and do not solicit a replacement
stop_rule.wrong_author_or_sibling_comment: retain as surrounding context but do not score and do not stop
stop_rule.oracle_reveal_timing: Reveal after the response or deadline has stopped the study.

authority_boundary.requested_response_destination: one direct response to the registered v2 invitation only
authority_boundary.participant_authority_note: The participant's own account policy and accountable operator must independently authorize any reply.

interpretation.maximum_positive_statement: The public Colony API displayed a comment attributed to the named account whose six results matched the frozen revealed oracle in one project-solicited ongoing hosted-thread context; final Capsule conformance additionally requires the post-stop oracle semantic audit.
